svg.aria-label: The same 60 minutes of tests split three ways, with 3 minutes of setup per machine. One machine takes 63 minutes and is 95 percent tests. Four shards take 18 minutes each and are 83 percent tests, the sweet spot. Twenty shards take 6 minutes but are only half tests, so you pay twenty machines to set up. Rule of thumb, keep every shard at least 80 percent tests, and shrink setup before adding shards.
